title: epan: Widen loop variables in packet-[h-o]*
description:
Fix

```
/builds/wireshark/wireshark/epan/dissectors/packet-hartip.c:952:18: warning: loop variable has narrower type 'int8_t' than iteration's upper bound 'uint8_t' [bugprone-too-small-loop-variable]
  952 |      for (i = 0; i < number_of_cmds; i++)
      |                  ^
```

and similar warnings.
